=== SHAPE OF THE FINDING ===
6 of 31 docs (19%) are ABSORB; 25 are benign. The benign 25 split cleanly: the QA-023 intermediate chain (6 docs) is superseded by already-cited summary docs (census-reconciliation / probe-fix / probe-defect / handcheck); the raw-instrument/data dumps (8 docs: .py/.zig/.json) are subsumed by their cited narrative .md siblings; the ops/context docs (7: races, suite, ledger, archive) are not evidence for a claim at all.

The 6 ABSORB docs fall into exactly two shapes, both of the T372 family but at lower severity than the original (the rows at least SAY the result happened; they do not say it never ran):
(a) ASSERTED-EVIDENCE-UNCITED — the row asserts a load-bearing evidentiary fact whose evidence doc is uncited (the QA-018 trio: 'unanimous SOUND' with no review report cited; the I11 PROVENANCE: exhaustive numbers cited only via the findings JSON; the T366 old-vs-new doc: three rows reference 'T366's figures/corpus' with no pointer).
(b) STALE-SCOPE-CONTRADICTION — 4x4.FP1 and GLOBAL.H4 still carry 'I11 is a 50,000-state sample (0.05%)', which T473 rescinded and 4x4.C1 already contradicts. This is the closest to T372: the register tells readers a scope limit that no longer holds.

The reason the other 50 citations (25 docs) were never worth citing is structural, not negligence: the register cites SUMMARY and SUPERSEDING docs, and raw instruments/data are deliberately kept out of the register's evidence column. That discipline is correct and is why only 6/31 needed citing.

=== POPULATION OUTSIDE docs/evidence/ (reasoned estimate) ===
The 56 citations / 31 docs are what ONE scan found by checking findings-file evidence paths against the register — a narrow lens that only sees evidence named in a findings file. It cannot see (a) evidence docs no findings file names, (b) evidence named only in research/audit prose, or (c) anything under gitignored untracked/ (where T13's probe source was destroyed). docs/evidence/ has 63 top-level entries and its subdirs hold ~20+ more files (QA-023, QA-026, BATTERY, ORACLE-V2, T571-*, T416-*); the 31 uncited are a floor. Outside it, the register sweeps only a fixed 'Sources swept' list (~15 docs) and declares a 'Not swept' list (methods-and-findings, arena-audit, query-engine, scaling-census, enumeration-census, ko-examples, strategy-open-questions, teaching-oracle-metrics, fresh-start-vs-real-game, ghi-and-superko, oracle-5x5-pv, GLOSSARY, names, HANDOVER, docs/engine/*) — each of which may carry additional uncited evidence. The uncited rate is plausibly HIGHER in the unswept trees than in the curated docs/evidence/. Reasoned estimate: ~100-200 additional uncited-evidence documents across docs/research/, docs/audits/, docs/decisions/, docs/epistemic/boards/, and the Not-swept list, with untracked/ an unquantifiable blind spot. This is an estimate, not a measurement; the only defensible lower bound is 31 (the in-directory count).
